The Meiyerditch Laboratories location is a multi-combat area where a dwarf multicannon can be used to kill mutated bloodveld. The area is only accessible with partial completion of Sins of the Father (after killing the mutated bloodveld during the quest). However, the run to the Meiyerditch Laboratories is fairly long, so it is recommended to use Prayer there instead of food.

The Buccaneers' Laboratory location is also a multi-combat area where a dwarf multicannon can be used to kill mutated bloodveld. 76 Sailing is required to access this area. Players are recommended to build a rowboat on the island, which allows easy access through Pirates' Cove.

Using the Expert Reanimation spell on an ensouled bloodveld head, players can reanimate a bloodveld for greatly reduced slayer experience. However, the player also receives 1,040 Prayer experience for each kill.

If the spell is not cast within a reasonable amount of time of picking up the head, or if the player trades the head or teleports away, then the user will need to reanimate the heads at the Dark Altar in Kourend.
